review_basis:
Twenty-second golden, a second sheet from the same fresh Maine BGS heat-pump-upgrade project as `jonesboro-m101.json`. A grid sweep of this sheet's own second mechanical plan (M-102, 'Mechanical First Floor Plan') near several `1" CD`/`3/4" CD` text anchors found a real, clean horizontal condensate-drain main. Unlike this project's own M-101 golden (a manual size override, since M-101's own candidate carried no automatic bind), this run gets a genuine LIVE AUTOMATIC bind: `trace_run` itself reports `size:{kind:"pipe",nps_in:1}, systems:["CD"]` directly, via `size-binding:beside` on a `pen-weight-prior` stroke family (`confidence:0.5`) -- the first real automatic size+system read on this project, and the first anywhere in this session's own recent run of goldens (Runs 37-45 all needed manual overrides due to missing PDF layer names on their own source files).

Both ends confirmed via marked render crop: the left end is a real `dead_end` at a drawn connection-point symbol near unit IU-14; the right end is a genuine `ambiguous` fork near a real curved wall/door element beyond room STOR-111A. This same sweep also independently reconfirmed a real, concrete instance of the hatching/dense-geometry pathology already disclosed in Run 45's own writeup: FOUR separate nearby seeds (x=1170-1230, y=1050-1080, all within ~60px of clean, valid candidates) returned wildly implausible ~3918-3919 LF traces capped at 4,000 points -- avoided entirely, not used, the seed for this golden chosen well clear of that zone. The run's own bench-style reseed (40% into its single segment) was independently re-verified live and reproduces the identical automatic bind and result.
scope: A single real 1-inch condensate-drain (CD) pipe main (18.83 LF) on the same Maine BGS heat-pump-upgrade project's own first-floor mechanical plan, sheet M-102, from a real connection-point symbol near indoor unit IU-14 to a real fork near a curved wall/door element beyond room STOR-111A. Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE: the connection's own continuation at either end; a real, disclosed hatching-density pathology zone on this same sheet (four seeds near x=1170-1230,y=1050-1080 returned implausible ~3918 LF results capped at 4,000 points), not used; every other CD/L-S run visible on this same rich sheet; sheet M-101 already used, and every other sheet on this real multi-part plan set.
